name: mechanistic target of rapamycin kinase
pathways: positive regulation of protein kinase activity

function.text: MTOR encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase mTOR. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein kinase activity and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant); macrocephaly-intellectual disability-neurodevelopmental disorder-small thorax syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MTOR have been reported in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.
